name: IP Systems
summary: Enterprise VoIP/IP-telephony provider (IP Systems Pty Ltd, ex-Consultant Connections 1994, renamed IP Systems ~2001); one of Australia's first ASPs and first to offer hosted IP telephony on BroadSoft; NOCs incl. Perth; acquired by Amcom 25 Feb 2010 (up to ~$20.5m); entity now AMCOM IP TEL Pty Ltd.

events.details: Founded (Consultant Connections (Aust) Pty Ltd, registered 9 Jun 1994); became IP Systems ~2001.
